scope: Flutter Android listener-only integration against an owned disposable Go/PostgreSQL/LiveKit QA stack: close and recover the application realtime WebSocket while retaining the existing LiveKit Room and refreshing the authoritative voice roster.

environment.runtime: Android 15 / API 35 AOSP emulator; Flutter integration test
environment.server: Owned disposable QA stack built from the same clean repository source; no production service

scenario.application_websocket: closed by the test, then a replacement socket connected

visual_review.observation: At source resolution, Android Flutter shows the listener voice dock as connected after app-socket and roster recovery; no reconnect banner is visible. This capture does not prove audible media.

limits.media: NOT_RUN: no RTP counters, received samples, audio output or audible assertion in this target
limits.background: NOT_RUN: this Flutter integration target stayed foreground; no Android Home/lock duration is claimed
limits.physical_acceptance: NOT_RUN: emulator only; no physical Android or iOS device
limits.release: NOT_RUN: no installed release artifact or production rollout

limitations: This is supplemental verification of Android Flutter app-socket recovery while a listener Room remains live; it is not the issue’s background-media acceptance.
Microphone FGS admission, background/lock behavior, audible playback, network switching, iOS audio session, and release artifacts remain unverified.
Issue #785 remains open and this result does not close its release gate.
